description: DRM evaluation queries for Milestone 4. Each query is scoped to one known source document (the ground-truth document id is the file stem). The corpus is deliberately composed of NDAs that share near-identical boilerplate so that, without Summary-Augmented Chunking (SAC), the retriever pulls boilerplate chunks from the wrong document.
